title: Zoho Analytics AI Reports: Build Executive Dashboards in Seconds #Shorts
description:
Learn how Zoho Analytics uses Zia Insights and natural language prompts to replace manual SQL report building with instant executive summaries.

1. In Zoho Analytics, import workspaces from Zoho CRM and Zoho Books into a unified data model.
2. Open Ask Zia and query complex revenue variance and customer metrics in plain English.
3. Click Auto-Generate Insights to let Zia attach narrative diagnostic summaries alongside visual trend charts.

API / tool used:
- name: Ask Zia Natural Language Query Engine
- endpoint: POST /restapi/v2/analytics/workspaces/YOUR_ORG_ID/askzia
- scope: ZohoAnalytics.fullaccess.all
- docs: Zoho Analytics API Documentation

AI + Zoho automations every day - follow @GSXAutomation
